title: WIND BREAKER
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Haruka Sakura, a lonely fighter who only wants to be the strongest, enrolls at Furin High, a notorious delinquent school. He discovers that its students, known as Bofurin, act as protectors of their town of Makochi, and the residents thank him for fights he picks with gangs. Under leader Hajime Umemiya, Sakura learns to fight for others and to accept friendship.
life_message: It holds up using strength to protect your community and learning to trust and belong.
